description: Immutable input snapshot manifest for article 26, United States 2019-2025
reuse_policy: Original FRED CSV snapshots were independently frozen for article 25; those identical source bytes are retained here so article 26 remains self-contained and offline-reproducible.

sources.source: United States Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.temporal_scope: 2018-01 through 2025-12; 2018 required for 2019 12-month CPI changes; missing October 2025 values are published dashes in six series

sources.source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, via FRED
sources.units: Thousands of employees, monthly, seasonally adjusted

sources.source: Bureau of Economic Analysis, National Income and Product Accounts, via FRED
sources.units: Billions of chained dollars, quarterly, seasonally adjusted annual rate

sources.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
sources.units: Percent, monthly average, not seasonally adjusted

sources.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
sources.units: Millions of US dollars, weekly Wednesday

sources.format: FRED multi-series graph export CSV, additional original columns preserved
sources.source: Federal Housing Finance Agency all-transactions U.S. House Price Index via FRED
sources.units: Quarterly house-price index, not seasonally adjusted

sources.format: FRED multi-series graph export CSV, additional original columns preserved
sources.source: United States Census Bureau, Current Population Survey ASEC, via FRED
sources.units: Real median household money income in 2025 USD; household money-income Gini, annually
